name: Purism×Egoist
source:
Main character is a genius first-rate scientist on android life form who abandons all his fame and starts to work as a local computer engineer. He lives a quiet life. One day he creates female android Piz. Fun and naughty life gradually transforms his life into a positive one. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
